artworks.title: Thenot Remonstrates with Colinet, Lightfoot in Background
artworks.description: The image is a small, rectangular illustration placed centrally on a blank page. The horizon line is situated near the middle of the illustration, with two figures standing on either side of a sheep. There is a faint outline of trees or buildings in the distance. The style appears to be a woodcut or engraving, with crisp lines and high contrast between black and white. The entire page has a monochromatic color palette with the illustration rendered in black against the beige tone of the paper.

artworks.title: Colinet Departs in Sorrow
artworks.description: The image features a small black and white illustration on a light brown page. The scene shows two figures interacting, with one raising their arms. A tree with a twisty trunk is to the right, and sheep are gathered in the background. The landscape slopes gently upward, possibly indicating a horizon line. The style uses linear brushstrokes and crosshatching for texture and shadow, creating depth. The color palette is monochrome with black ink on light paper.

artworks.title: Blasted Tree and Flattened Crops
artworks.description: The image shows a small, black and white engraving of a landscape view from a lower vantage point. There is a gnarled tree in the foreground, with detailed bark textures. Beyond the tree are wavy lines indicating hills or fields. The horizon is near the upper third, with a crescent moon against a dark sky filled with subtle lines for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using black, white, and gray for contrast. The image is framed by a plain margin.

artworks.title: Shepherd Chases away Wolf
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from a slightly elevated point of view looking into a valley. The horizon line is at the top edge of the drawing with hills or mountains in the distance. There is a structure among trees, depicted with detailed lines. The style is similar to a woodcut or engraving with stark black and white contrasts, cross-hatching, and line work for depth. The trees have swirling lines and the buildings are more structured. The color palette is black ink on a beige page for tonal contrast.

artworks.title: 'Sabrina's silvery flood'
artworks.description: The image shows a black ink illustration on a beige backdrop. A landscape is depicted with a river meandering through the scene. The horizon is high, showing trees and the sky with horizontal lines. A cottage sits on the right among trees, defined by shadows and details created with strokes. The artwork is in black and white with bold, textured strokes.

artworks.title: Colinet's Journey
artworks.description: This is a small black-and-white print on a larger sheet of tan paper. The small print shows undulating hills under a thin strip of light sky. A path winds through bushes and shrubs around the hills, and there is a person standing on it. The person is on the left side of the print next to a small, pointed structure with "LXII" engraved on its side. The person holds a long stick and wears a hat and a long, flowing garment.

artworks.title: 'A rolling stone is ever bare of moss'
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person pulling a large barrel or container across a path in front of a building. It is situated in the center of a larger beige-colored page. The drawing depicts an outdoor environment with a pathway bordered by a large building in the background, an older style with visible details such as windows and a door. A tree appears prominently on the right side of the frame, and the sky above is marked with lines suggesting a textured or sky-filled background. The drawing emphasizes strong contrasts between the dark ink and the lighter background.

artworks.title: Colinet Resting by Night
artworks.description: The image features a small, black and white print at the center of a tan, textured paper. The scene shows a nighttime landscape with a crescent moon in the sky and a figure resting next to a tree. The print uses woodcut lines to depict texture and shadows, with the background suggesting rolling terrain. The bold shadows and strokes create a dramatic monochromatic palette, highlighting the contrast between light and dark. The compact size of the print emphasizes its details against the paper's expanse.

artworks.title: Colinet Mocked by Two Boys
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a forest with figures and trees. The central image is crafted in black and white against a plain background, depicting three figures within a wooded landscape. The figures stand among large, darkly-shaded trees, giving the appearance of a dense forest. The figures are positioned to interact with each other or the environment, creating a narrative element in the artwork. The intricate details of shading suggest depth and complexity, adding a sense of mystery or drama to the scene. Overall, the artwork conveys a classical style, reminiscent of traditional etchings that emphasize strong contrast and fine detail.

artworks.title: Menalcas Watching Women Dance
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in dynamic poses with architectural elements. The figures appear engaged in a dance or ritual, with swirling garments and raised arms creating movement. The background includes columns and pediments. The style gives it a timeless quality, reminiscent of classical or mythological themes in historical artworks. Black ink on a plain tan background highlights the details and adds to the historical feel of the scene.

artworks.title: Thenot and Colinet Lead their Flocks Together
artworks.description: This is an image featuring figures and a structure in an outdoor setting. The drawing shows two figures in front of a wooden fence or gate with a rustic roofline. There are elements of nature surrounding them, such as trees or foliage. The drawing is detailed with a textural appearance, resembling a woodcut or engraving style.

artworks.title: Thenot and Colinet Eat their Evening Meal
artworks.description: The image features a small etching or print depicting two seated individuals within a structure resembling a hut. One figure is positioned on the left side of a table, and the other on the right. Both individuals are seated on chairs facing each other across the table. The person on the left is shown in a side profile, facing towards the table, and the individual on the right is similarly seated with a side profile view. The figures appear to be dressed in long garments. The hut has a thatched roof, and the background is dark, emphasizing the scene. The larger brown paper provides a textured surface and frames the illustration centrally.

artworks.title: Boy Returning Joyfully with Plough and Oxen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures and an animal in a pastoral setting. The artwork is a black and white drawing set against a plain page, featuring a small group of figures standing together in a natural landscape. The figures are detailed with flowing garments, and there is an animal with prominent horns among them. In the background, subtle line work suggests a landscape with elevated terrain or hills, with possibly a sun or a moon partially visible behind the horizon, emitting rays that fill the scene with a sense of distance and depth. The figures and setting combine to evoke a story or theme of pastoral life.

artworks.title: Return of the Shepherd
artworks.description: This is a small engraving positioned on a larger brown paper background. The scene depicts a person holding a long staff or rod who is leading two oxen or cows towards the left across a flat landscape. The horizon is low in the image, with a setting sun partially visible behind a low hill on the right, indicated by rays emanating into the cloudy sky. The color palette is monochrome with varying intensities of black and white, against the warm brown of the surrounding page.

artworks.title: The Pastorals of Virgil
artworks.medium: wood engraving (4 proofs on uncut sheet)
artworks.description: The image is divided into four horizontal panels of rustic landscape scenes. The top panel features an old tree and rolling hills under a crescent moon. The second panel shows a woman near a wooden structure in the woods. The third panel displays a path leading to a house among trees. The fourth panel shows a figure with a staff at a crossroads. The engraving has detailed textures and a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: The Pastorals of Virgil
artworks.medium: wood engraving (4 proofs on uncut sheet)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four pastoral scenes stacked vertically, each depicting interactions in a natural setting with sheep and figures. The first scene shows two robed figures standing on either side of a tree with a sun setting behind rolling hills. The second scene features a reclining figure under a curving tree with a full moon and a spherical object in the night sky. The third panel displays a robed figure holding a shepherd's staff watching over a small flock of sheep, with a dynamic figure leaping in the background. The final scene mirrors the first, depicting two robed figures on either side of a bare, twisted tree, with two visible sheep. Each scene employs delicate, fine lines to form textured details of the landscape, figures, and animals.

artworks.title: Restrike from fragment of cancelled plate for "A Prophecy"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of faint handwriting on a textured surface. The drawing features a subtle and mostly obscured section of handwritten text. The ink appears to have been applied with a gentle touch, creating a delicate and ephemeral quality to the writing. The upper section might display additional dim lines. The entire composition carries a sense of antiquity and fragile beauty.

artworks.title: The Old Cock
artworks.medium: etching printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a print of a rooster among tall grass. The print is in brown lines against tan paper. The rooster is facing the right, and we can see its tall comb, its feathery wings and tail, and its scaly feet, which have more feathers around the ankles. The background features the tall grass under a blank sky.

artworks.title: The Doorway
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand, ornately designed doorway partially submerged in water. The drawing features an elaborate archway with intricate patterns and carvings. The water reaches the lower portion of the entrance. Behind the doorway, there is a recessed interior space with steps leading upward. Shadows and cross-hatching create an interplay of light and dark.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image shows a series of thin lines and shapes arranged in an intricate and abstract design. Among the lines and shapes are skeletal figures and ornate motifs, giving the piece a decorative quality. The lines curve and interweave to suggest foliage or vines, while small humanoid shapes engage in various activities. The central part features an emblem-like shape that resembles a coat of arms or decorative crest.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling lines, ornate shapes, flowers, vines, small human figures engaged in various activities, and designs resembling lanterns and musical instruments arranged in an intricate pattern.

artworks.title: Eglise de Saint-Taurin, Evreux
artworks.description: The image displays an artwork featuring a tall stone wall with arched windows, intricate patterns, slender columns, and vegetation on top. The foreground shows three figures in historical clothing having a conversation. The scene conveys a serene and ancient ambiance.

artworks.title: Bologna
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene with tall, narrow buildings lining an alleyway. A tower rises prominently above the structures. The architecture is detailed, with intricate facades and rooflines. The color palette is primarily sepia and black, giving a monochromatic appearance resembling an etching. Figures walk along the cobbled street close by, set in a historical setting. In the distance, more buildings complete the urban vista under a sky with swirling cloud patterns.

artworks.title: Tour du gros-horloge, Evreux
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view of a grand clock tower surrounded by medieval-style buildings. The tower rises prominently against the cloudy sky, detailed with gothic features and a flag on top. The art is intricate with precise brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, mostly gray. People in historical attire are depicted going about daily activities on the bustling street.
